body.html: Nakarin Hotel, known locally as Rong Raem Nakarin, is a small budget hotel of around 20 rooms on Moo 10, Bung Subdistrict, in Mueang Amnat Charoen district · It is a simple, practical, low-priced place — no fancy design or long facilities list — but it is honest about what travellers actually need: a clean, quiet room and somewhere to park.

Rooms come in a few types, from a Double with one big bed up to Classic Double/Twin and Deluxe rooms (around 20–24 sqm) · What guests consistently praise is that the rooms are clean, the bed is comfortable, the AC is cold and it is quiet at night · Every room has air conditioning, a fridge, TV, en-suite bathroom and free Wi-Fi · The in-room kit is basic but does the job and fits a price of just a few hundred baht — the kind of room that suits anyone who simply wants a clean bed for one night.
"Clean, quiet room with cold AC, and the parking is huge — very easy if you drive. There's a simple breakfast, the staff are friendly, and for a few hundred baht it's good value."

Parking is a big reason self-drivers like it · The hotel has a large, free car park that is easy to get in and out of, ideal if you are breaking up an Isan road trip or driving in on business · It sits in Bung Subdistrict, near Phra Mongkhon Ming Mueang Buddha Park (the large seated Buddha that is a symbol of Amnat Charoen) with the town centre only a short drive away · There are restaurants and convenience stores around, though it is quieter than the heart of town.

On breakfast, the hotel serves a simple morning meal — things like rice porridge, toast, orange juice and coffee · It is not a big buffet, but it is enough to start the day before you set off · There is an on-site restaurant and daily housekeeping · Staff earn praise for being friendly and helpful, and the front desk is open 24 hours, so a late check-in is no problem.

To be straight, per the real reviews: this is a 2-star budget hotel, not a luxury stay · Facilities are basic — no swimming pool or gym — and the building looks plain and a little dated for its age · The Bung Subdistrict location is not right in the centre, so anyone wanting to walk to the clock tower or night market will need to drive or grab a ride · Some reviews note the limited breakfast choice — all trade-offs for one of the lowest prices in town.

In short, if you want an Amnat Charoen stay that is clean, quiet, has big parking and the lowest possible price, Nakarin Hotel is a sensible pick for a night on the road · A score of around 8.0 from over 71 reviews on Agoda reflects honest value · It suits drivers passing through, people in town on business, or anyone keeping the accommodation budget low so there is more to spend elsewhere.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you are self-driving, this place handles parking well and is easy to reach · It is a small property, so calling ahead to check availability is worth it · And if you fancy paying respects, Phra Mongkhon Ming Mueang Buddha Park is close by — a good early-morning stop before you continue your journey.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Nakarin Hotel Amnat Charoen

faq.q: Where is Nakarin Hotel in Amnat Charoen, and what is nearby?
faq.a: Nakarin Hotel is at 86/1 Moo 10, Bung Subdistrict, Mueang Amnat Charoen · It is near Phra Mongkhon Ming Mueang Buddha Park (~3 km) and a roughly 5–7 minute drive to the town centre, clock tower and night market · There are restaurants and convenience stores around for food.

faq.q: How much does Nakarin Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about ฿400/night for a Double Room · There are Classic Double/Twin and Deluxe rooms (around 20–24 sqm) at roughly ฿480–฿580 · Rates vary by room type and season, so compare Agoda and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does Nakarin Hotel have breakfast and parking?
faq.a: Yes — there is a simple breakfast (rice porridge, toast, orange juice, coffee) and a large, free car park · The parking is a favourite of self-drivers and is easy to get in and out of · The front desk is open 24 hours for late check-ins.

faq.q: Who is Nakarin Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone wanting a cheap Amnat Charoen stay that is clean, quiet and has parking · Great for drivers passing through, people in town on business, or budget travellers · Not ideal if you want to walk around the town centre, or need a pool and full facilities.

faq.q: Are the rooms at Nakarin Hotel clean and quiet?
faq.a: Most real reviews say the rooms are clean, the AC is cold and it is quiet at night · It is a small hotel in Bung Subdistrict off the main road, so it is restful · The building looks plain and dated for its age, but cleanliness is well maintained for the price.

faq.q: Is Nakarin Hotel convenient for self-drivers?
faq.a: Very · The hotel has a large, free car park that is easy to access, ideal for self-drivers or a stopover on an Isan road trip · The Bung Subdistrict location reaches the town centre quickly and is close to the Buddha Park for a visit.
